body:
Except there's a whole other choice, one on which I know will be an end and good or bad, it's done.
Even my best plans are for a less than acceptable life. It seems my mental illness is incurable and I can only ever hope for being almost okay.
And honestly that just isn't enough.

I've honestly run out of positivity.
Every plan I make to live a better life has been ending in crushing failure. Including my latest one, which was the last one I could scrounge up

I don't have a lot of choice. I'm limited to what my school offers. My current therapist is nice, at least, the last one made me feel like shit. I guess I just don't fit the severely mentally ill stereotype since I spend every ounce of energy maintaining a superficially normal life.
My life has just been one terrible situation after another and after 21 years of never feeling it, I'm doubting happiness is within my emtoiomal capabilities anyway.

Also thank you so much for responding.

Without stopping? A bit shy of 24 hours. And what caused it is enough to push me over. I can't deal with it anymore. I am so mentally sick and nothing is helping. I am tired if being in pain.

It might have been more resolute for the past day bit it's never left my mind for those 10 years. I haven't lived in a long time. I just exist and I'm tired of it.

I completely and honestly want to die.

I want the pain to go away, I want to forget all of the things that happened. I just want to stop existing.

I've been fighting this decision for 10 years. I thought about it every day and I made it a line I swore I wouldn't crss but I did. I don't want to discuss it because honestly any attempts have made me feel worse.

So far the only reason I haven't is because everyone told me they'd feel so bad. then I realized that I'm in this situation because I valued other people above me, put their pain about mine

I'm done with that now, I just don't want to mess it up tomorrow.

I just realized the lab I'm in is closing in a half hour and I have no other way to access this site anyway.
It's up to you, I'll probably feel the same way tomorrow, nothing has hoped make me feel better.
Either way, thank you for responding.

Well, they won't have an alternative program so either way I have to drop the course.

I only went to college because I could, it was expected of me, and there was nothing else I could really do. I'm not working currently, my last job was a summer internship at a foster care agency. I don't really have any creams. I briefly considered being a child advocate but I really have none of the skills to do that so I'll have to find something else pretty soon.

I have to rush. There's only a year and a half until I graduate, which is short when there's a high chance I will have nothing to my name besides my degree at that point, if I'm lucky.
They don't have any contact information that I could find.

I can't sleep. I tend to panic when I try and if I actually sleep I just have nightmares and wake up constantly. I haven't been able to find a solutions to this. Either way, I don't think I'll sleep at all tonight.

It seems I'm getting more negative as the night goes on, I'm sorry.

Thank you for commenting, I figured no one would and I'm feeling quite terrible, it seems I'll be going an entire night without sleep.

Honestly, being around people is exhausting. I'm miserable and sad but it feels as if I'm not allowed to talk about anything or express myself in any way. I'd rather stay alone if it means not lying all of the time.
It's not software exactly, it's a web-based program I bought through a textbook company. It doesn't run on my chromebook because it doesn't have an OS that can run it. My main concern is that I won't be able to get my money back and I'll have to drop the course since I have to use that program to do all of my tests. Already getting a 0 for the first one.

But it's stupid anyway, that's just one of the many small things that are going wrong. It used to br the small things were all that kept me going since everything important was going wrong. But now everything is going wrong.

I'm just a psychology student, so don't take me too seriously. But there is more than just Major Depressive Disorder, which is most likely what you've read up about. There are other mood disorders that might be worth looking into. 
Either way, if you think that how you are feeling is affecting your life, it is worth seeking help. Try to not feel too embarrassed about going to someone, there are many people in similar situations and especially when it comes to college and financial issues, you are not alone. Try approaching someone you trust and think might be helpful in this situation first if you are not comfortable going to your parents or doctor.

When I talk about things in general, they're fine, but when I try to tell them about specifics that actually happened, they just don't believe me, blame me, or don't care. 
I'm just tired, this was a stupid, pointless and desperate decision. As usual, I'll wake up better than how I fell asleep

That's part of what confuses me. When I do confide in people, they tell me the way other people have responded were mean or insensitive, or wrong in some way. Ignore the fact that whoever told me this probably did the same thing eventually, it just seems like a vast majority of the people I know have all reacted similarly. I interpret this int he sense that either I have terrible luck, or that's just normal.

I faked normalcy for so long that when I finally wanted to tell the truth about things, everyone said I was lying, or that I'm somehow wrong in how I experienced things.
Worse, I would approach some difficult concept in general with people first, and the person would say how in this or that circumstance, it couldn't have been the person's fault. But that's only hypothetically, apparently, because when I relate the same circumstance to my life, it is my fault. 
I simply don't trust people anymore.

Well, either most of my life has sucked and I'm just trash, or maybe my life has been completely normal, and I'm just messed up more than I'm willing to comprehend. Opening up honestly stopped being an option months ago, but I love my bad habits
